lead_story: The US dollar had a weak week due to doubts about the Fed's ability to address inflation, US Treasury yields fell as oil prices dropped on hopes of de-escalation in Iran, and the US took joint action with Japan to prop up the yen, all of which are driving market sentiment right now, with the Fed's next move being closely watched by investors.
